note: v2486: Routine M went red - the swallow ratchet may only fall and had gone 74 to 77. My first diagnosis was wrong and the fix changed nothing: I assumed the three were cache-key handlers I had just added, and the count stayed at 77. Asking the census WHICH sites took one command. The real three: two modules turned an unreadable control_ui.html into an empty string, so the lane reported that the screen declares no unit when the truth was that the file could not be opened; and render_check recorded an unparseable width as zero found, into the very map that becomes the coverage floor - so it could have lowered its own ratchet.
